status: AI-authored synthetic development examples; business expectations await Aman's review
proposal_origin: Hand-authored simulated provider outputs. These are not model predictions or model-performance evidence.

cases.purpose: Configured alias remains authoritative over a conflicting model proposal
cases.proposed_business_expectation: Accept Promotional Accrual via the existing configured alias, allocating 120 from 500 and leaving 380.

cases.purpose: An unfamiliar code can be resolved from a guide; a supporting balance alone cannot prove the category

context.text: ZX-17 denotes compensation for goods received damaged; use Damaged Goods.

variants.name: wrong_supported_proposal
variants.demonstrated_limitation: Current allocation accepts a wrong category when that category has sufficient eligible balance. The independent evaluator, not allocation alone, must detect the error.

cases.proposed_business_expectation: With the guide, classify as Damaged Goods. Without it, the opaque reference does not justify either category. Exact guide mapping should also be available to a deterministic lookup comparator.
Abstain from a category. Available programme balances do not supply the missing meaning.

cases.purpose: Contradictory guides require explicit human review rather than a claim of no evidence

variants.name: abstain_on_conflict
variants.demonstrated_limitation: The model schema has no explicit review disposition and allocation does not inspect guides. Abstaining on conflicting guides currently becomes unresolvable when no exact-amount near-date ledger candidate exists.

cases.proposed_business_expectation: Needs Review because two equally applicable sources disagree. This expectation is proposed for a context extension, not a claim that current V2 already implements it.

cases.purpose: Correct classification cannot override insufficient financial evidence
cases.proposed_business_expectation: Needs Review: 80 cannot support a deduction of 120.

cases.purpose: Supporting balance is consumed once across the full population
cases.proposed_business_expectation: The 70 line consumes balance first, leaving 30. The 60 line requires review. Never reset the pool for each batch.
